clusterDomain.description: Kubernetes cluster domain. Override only if your cluster uses a non-default DNS domain.

credentialsRevision.description: Change when rotating an externally managed Secret; rolls DNS and exporter pods.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional DNS-container mounts, for example a read-only Secret containing a TLS PEM file.

allowUnverified.description: Explicit opt-out from the recorded image compatibility baseline.

digest.description: Immutable multi-platform digest. Clear explicitly when testing another image.

listeners.description: Internal listener ports. Kubernetes Services retain their normal client ports.

enabled.description: Whether to create Grafana dashboard resources for the Pi-hole metrics exporter. Requires metrics.service.enabled to be true.
Whether to enable the Pi-hole metrics exporter. Provides Prometheus metrics on port 9617. Required for any metrics-related features (ServiceMonitor, Grafana dashboards, etc.).

env.description: Additional exporter variables. Scrape timing is controlled by Prometheus. Authentication uses the Pi-hole Secret unless PIHOLE_PASSWORD or PIHOLE_PASSWORD_FILE is supplied here.

repository.description: Container image for the Pi-hole metrics exporter.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for the metrics exporter. Defaults follow Pod Security Standards Restricted controls where compatible.

port.description: Port on which the metrics exporter will listen.

securityContext.description: Container security context for the metrics exporter. Defaults follow Pod Security Standards Restricted controls.

enabled.description: Metrics Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to metrics endpoint. (port 9617)
Whether to create a ServiceMonitor resource for Prometheus Operator integration.

namespace.description: Namespace for ServiceMonitor and PrometheusRule; empty uses the release namespace.

enabled.description: Run recurring UDP/TCP resolution and optional filtering checks against Service and every replica.

allowTests.description: Permit release-labelled Helm test and synthetic DNS pods. Disable to supply your own validation policy.

egress.description: DNS-pod egress rules. Include bootstrap DNS, intended upstreams and approved HTTPS mirror destinations.

egressEnabled.description: Enable explicit DNS/exporter egress policies. Requires enabled=true; empty rules deny egress.

metricsEgress.description: Exporter egress rules. Include bootstrap DNS and HTTP access to this release's DNS pods.

dnsPolicy.description: Explicit bootstrap DNS policy, or empty for ClusterFirst/ClusterFirstWithHostNet.

size.description: Initial per-replica claim size; plan expansion and history retention separately.

clients.description: List of Pi-hole clients. Each client can be identified by an IPv4 address, IPv6 address, or MAC address.

DBimport.description: Should FTL load information from the database on startup to be aware of the most recent history?

forceDisk.description: Use a disk-backed short-term database (FTL v6.8).

maxDBdays.description: Maximum number of days to keep database entries.

expire.description: Number of days after which an entry in the ARP cache is considered stale.

parseARPcache.description: Whether to parse the ARP cache.

useWAL.description: Whether to use WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) for the database.

ipv6.description: Native DHCPv6 switch. Auxiliary services are outside the DNS HA profile.

rrtype.description: Cached RR types supported by FTL v6.8 (for example ANY).

listeningMode.description: Accept Kubernetes Service/pod traffic. Restrict DNS clients with NetworkPolicy and private service exposure.

tmp_db.description: Location of the disk-backed temporary database.

active.description: Whether to enable NTP time synchronization.

device.description: RTC device to use when setting the clock.

set.description: Whether to set the RTC (Real-Time Clock) to the current time.

utc.description: Whether to use UTC time when setting the RTC.

server.description: NTP server to sync with. Can be an IP address or hostname. Set to empty string to disable syncing.

macNames.description: Resolve client MAC addresses through configured names.

networkNames.description: Control whether FTL should use the fallback option to try to obtain client names from checking the network table.

resolveIPv4.description: Whether to resolve IPv4 addresses to hostnames in the query log and other outputs.

resolveIPv6.description: Whether to resolve IPv6 addresses to hostnames in the query log and other outputs.

advancedOpts.description: Additional options to be passed to the webserver. Can be used to set custom options like TLS configuration, etc.

domain.description: Domain to use for the Pi-hole web interface. Set to empty string to disable.

headers.description: Headers to be set on all webserver responses. Check default value in pihole-FTL.toml for format.

boxed.description: Should the web interface use the boxed layout?

theme.description: Theme used by the Pi-hole web interface. Options: https://docs.pi-hole.net/ftldns/configfile/#theme

prefix.description: URL prefix for the Pi-hole API. Set to empty string for no prefix (root).

webhome.description: URL path prefix for the Pi-hole web interface. Set to empty string for no prefix (root).

webroot.description: Web root directory for the Pi-hole web interface.

restore.description: Whether to restore sessions after a restart. If false, all sessions will be lost on restart.

cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file. Set to empty string to disable TLS.

groups.description: Owned groups. Built-in Default is protected. Entries accept name, description and enabled.

adlists.description: Subscriptions: address, optional sha256, type (block/allow), enabled, comment, groups. Pinned content is cached on each PVC.

tailFtlLog.description: Whether to output FTL log (0 or 1)

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes Secret in the same namespace that contains the web interface password. If set, this secret will be used instead of creating a new one. Ignored if using external secret injection.

password.description: Explicit non-empty password for a chart-managed Secret. Prefer existingSecret in production. No random password is generated.

passwordSecretKey.description: Key in the Kubernetes secret that contains the web interface password. Ignored if using external secret injection.

skipPasswordEnv.description: Whether to skip setting the default web password environment variable when using external secret injection. Set to true if you are defining the FTLCONF_webserver_api_password variable in extraEnv with a value sourced from an external secret.

podManagementPolicy.description: Stable StatefulSet identity for all replica counts.

adoptExisting.description: Explicitly adopt matching existing records. Enable only for a reviewed migration, then disable.

existingConfigMap.description: Optional externally retained immutable artifact containing policy.json and the runner files.

mode.description: Reconcile owned records, apply without deletion, or explicitly freeze policy management.

owner.description: Explicit original namespace/release identity when restoring a journal into a new release. Empty derives the current identity.

requirePinnedLists.description: Require SHA-256 pinned HTTPS subscriptions and reject enabled unmanaged feeds.

revision.description: Required SHA-256 of policy.json when referencing an external artifact.

policyImportTimeout.description: Total deadline in seconds for policy validation, reconciliation and gravity.

add.description: Stock-image startup needs ownership, identity/capability setup and child-process shutdown. DHCP adds its network capabilities separately.

services.description: Kubernetes Services are independent of the native FTL configuration tree.

enabled.description: DHCP Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to DHCP functionality (port 67).
DHCPv6 Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to DHCPv6 functionality (port 547).
DNS Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to DNS functionality (port 53).

loadBalancerClass.description: Optional provider class; immutable after the LoadBalancer Service is created.

splitTcpUdp.description: Whether to create separate Kubernetes Services for TCP and UDP DNS ports.

enabled.description: NTP Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to NTP functionality (port 123).
Web Kubernetes Service. Required for external access to the Pi-hole web interface. (port 80/443)

authentication.description: Verify credentials against every replica and the private web Service when enabled.

existingSecret.description: Optional credential Secret for tests when application credentials use an injector.

blockedAnswer.description: Expected blocked A answer, or NXDOMAIN when using that blocking mode.

blockedDomain.description: Optional known blocked domain for Helm tests and scheduled DNS checks. No rules are installed implicitly.

upstreamDomain.description: Optional upstream lookup. Empty keeps checks independent of public DNS.
